text: a train travels a distance of 40 km per hour on an average with stoppages its speed is 50 km per hour. How much time on an average per hour it stops
explanation:

 This means that in one hour, the train effectively loses 10 km of travel distance due to stoppages. 
 The time taken to cover 10 km at the actual (no stoppage) speed of 50 km/h is the time the train was stopped.
